purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, viewer/service evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: ESA official pages evidence an Egyptian national survey/map custodian and digital-map procedure; the Sohag governorate page evidences Al-Manshah administratively. No public anonymous parcel feature response was verified.
registryAssessment: The ESA is a national agency, not a proven Al-Manshah municipal registry office. Its official pages describe survey, digital-map, and property-related map services. The reviewed Sohag page identifies مركز ومدينة المنشاة but does not expose a cadastral parcel service.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official ESA services page lists survey/map and land-related services, including digital and paper maps.
Official ESA digital-map page says customers request a specified location, scale, layers, format, and projection; it describes a mediated purchase workflow rather than an anonymous parcel API.
Official Sohag governorate administrative page identifies مركز ومدينة المنشاة and local units; it is administrative evidence, not parcel geometry evidence.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Official HTML service pages; no public map viewer JavaScript/configuration or feature-service URL was exposed in the reviewed pages.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Not exposed for a parcel feature layer; ESA digital-map procedure allows a requested projection but does not document a public parcel API schema.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: First-party page found by web discovery; page content lists ESA map/survey services. A separate direct curl retrieval timed out after 20 seconds; no retry with altered TLS settings was made.

First-party digital-map procedure found by web discovery; it describes requesting and purchasing maps with selected location/layers/projection. No anonymous parcel feature endpoint or parcel schema was exposed.
First-party Sohag page found by web discovery; it identifies مركز ومدينة المنشاة and local administrative units. No parcel API or geometry response.
Official ESA paper-map search route found during source review; it provides map-scale/name controls, not a parcel feature response.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying safe anonymous parcel response was verified.

geometryEvidence.query: No parcel geometry query was submitted because no documented public parcel feature endpoint or layer schema was exposed by the official sources reviewed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: ESA national survey/map services plus Sohag governorate administrative identification of Al-Manshah.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous complete-polygon feature response verified.

remainingUncertainty: No local cadastral office custodian, public parcel service URL, native identity field, CRS, or current parcel response was independently verified. Timeout, missing API, or general agency/service prose is not evidence of cadastral absence.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous ID-plus-geometry response; packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
